ai_note: Management's 'All in AI' / Lingxi APP 3.0 is an internal productivity and client-retention tool (cost cutting, advisory engagement), not a demand driver; the revenue surge is entirely explained by mainland trading volumes and the Haitong merger, with no AI-capex or AI-disruption link.
why: The acceleration (growth 12% / 17.1% / 83.6%, H1 FY2026 interim +81.2% YoY) is mainland China equity-market beta -- SSE/SZSE average daily turnover roughly doubled YoY and margin-lending balances hit records -- stacked on top of the March 2025 Guotai Junan/Haitong absorption merger that also doubled the share count. The DCF's own base-case narrative calls this 'a cycle around a ~3% nominal trend, not a trend' and mean-reverts revenue down 6-10% in FY2027-28; the historical_growth note explicitly flags that every aggregate CAGR here is inflated by the merger.
watch: SSE/SZSE average daily turnover -- the H1 2026 ~RMB3.21tn/day run rate is the entire growth story; a reversion toward the ~RMB1.6tn pre-boom level would end the 'acceleration' within a quarter

Post-merger integration costs and credit losses on the combined RMB300bn+ margin book, especially with the July 2026 president resignation leaving a leadership gap during active IT/entity consolidation

ROE, currently 11.1% (3yr avg 8.2%), failing the returns screen -- the DCF's own terminal ROE (~8%) sits below its 11% cost of equity, meaning even management's base case does not clear the quality bar this list applies

Price versus the $9.35 base-case entry price (HKD) -- at HKD13.23 the stock trades above both the base DCF entry and base intrinsic value of HKD14.22 only in the bull scenario; bear-case fair value is ~HKD8.60
next_catalyst: FY2026 full-year results, expected March 2027, plus any update on the pending Indonesian securities-firm acquisition and the new president appointment
exclude_reason: Growth is a mainland China trading-volume cycle compounded by the 2025 Haitong absorption merger -- both cyclical and acquisition-driven, which the DCF's own narrative concedes mean-reverts; not durable, quality-driven acceleration.
